utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Appreciate it, Ira. I’ll jot down a clear list and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll check back in after I’m done and see if anyone’s heard anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Can you bring the drill and a couple extension cords? That’d help us a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring the drill and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d double-check the timing first—if the trucks are late, everything gets backed up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, I should double-check the time first. If you hear anything, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I can help, I think. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — could you bring a roll of duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and any spare screws you’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can do that — duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and whatever spare screws I can find. I’ll bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the details first—what needs repairing, and what’s the plan for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I think it’s for the broken stuff folks dropped off, but I might’ve missed the full plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll confirm the list and the drive plan before we do anything else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — it’s going well so far. We’ve got a decent pile started, and folks are still dropping things off.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, glad to hear it. I’ll help sort or carry stuff if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you grab my ladder and the socket set? That’d really help me get the repair drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll grab your ladder and socket set now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked any repair-drive locations yet, but I can keep an eye out. If you tell me the target spot, I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — please note the target spot once I confirm it, and I’ll keep you posted about the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll note the target spot as soon as you confirm it, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s getting a nice little buzz going—I heard a few folks already dropped off tools and spare parts. If you’re heading over, you’ll probably find a good crowd there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear — I’ll swing by and spread the word to a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Quinn — the more neighbors who hear about it, the better. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive coming along, Rey?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s coming along steadily. I’ve been checking in with folks one by one, and we’re making progress.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear — do you need any help with the next round of check-ins?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll let people know what’s planned and keep repeating the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep checking in as the details come together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the details so folks stay in the loop. Just send me the latest plan whenever it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting together the repair drive list now, and I’d love your help with the final checks. When you’re ready, we can go over what still needs fixing and who can help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa, I’m ready to help with the final checks. Let’s go over what still needs fixing and who can take each one.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ve got a short list of fixes, and I’ll pair each one with a helper as we go. Let’s start with the biggest priorities first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout. If you’ve got anything to bring, now’s the time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I do have a couple of things I can bring by. I’ll stop in this afternoon and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Eli—thank you. I’ll be around this afternoon, so just drop them off whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we still need to sort the tool table, set out the donation boxes, and do one quick pass for any last-minute fixes. I’ll keep repeating the plan so nobody misses their bit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll take the tool table and do a quick pass for any last-minute fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rey. If you can bring some sturdy gloves and a flashlight, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing — I’ll bring sturdy gloves and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just bring a flashlight, a basic tool kit, and any spare batteries you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — flashlight, tool kit, and spare batteries. I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’d be great, Jules. Can you share the date, time, and what kinds of items or skills people should bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send around the date, time, and a quick list of useful items and skills. If you want, I can also help make it sound friendly and easy to share.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I’m here if you need help with it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I’d appreciate that. I’ll send over the details so you can jump in where it’s most useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — send them over when you can, and I’ll pitch in where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, Gus — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t heard a firm update yet, Ira, but I’m keeping an eye out and can swing by to help once they set a time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. Let me know as soon as you hear a time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m sorting the tools and could use a hand loading them up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help load the tools up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to sort the timing and pickup details first so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time works for you, and should I arrange pickup or meet you there?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If you can do pickup, that’s easiest for me — I’m free after 5, and I’d like to confirm the exact address too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—if you’re free, come by and bring a friend!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and see if I can bring someone along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks! I’ll keep you posted on the time and any supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive planned for?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks for asking. I haven’t locked in the time yet, but I’ll check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just let me know once you have it and I’ll work around the school drop-off and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep Nell posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I really appreciate it. Just keep me posted when you have the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll send you the time and place as soon as it’s set.
